card.text: Young A-type star in Centaurus whose planet was the first exoplanet JWST photographed.

sources.label: Carter et al. 2023

introduction.text: HIP 65426 is a young, hot, fast-spinning star 108 parsecs away. Its giant planet b was found in 2017 and became JWST's first directly imaged exoplanet.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.
